classifications.evidence_quote: We could not finish account setup because the invitation link expired before our admin used it.
The setup checklist doesn’t explain whether workspace creation comes before importing team members.
Our first-time admin needed three separate calls to understand how roles and permissions work during setup.
I signed up yesterday but the welcome screen never tells me what to do next.
The setup wizard resets after step two and I have to reenter the same company settings.
Every assignment update sends an email and a push notification. It is impossible to focus.
We need one daily digest instead of five near-identical activity alerts per team.
Managers cannot mute low-priority reminders, so they are ignoring all notifications.
Please let me choose push only or email only. I do not need both for every event.
The product continues emailing resolved-ticket reminders a day after completion.
I can see total tickets but can’t find a breakdown by issue category in the analytics screen.
The weekly report is buried behind three menus and the export button is hard to discover.
Our team leaders need to filter dashboard results by region, not only by company-wide totals.
I wish charts explained what the trends mean; right now the dashboard is confusing.
We need to compare first-response times across teams without manually combining several reports.
Our invoice shows an add-on we did not recognize and I cannot find the price breakdown.
The renewal notification never explains how our seat count affects the next bill.
The pricing page lists two plans but fails to explain the overage charges.
Why did the trial convert to a paid plan? The notice should show the charge before renewal.
I need to see taxes and discounts separately when downloading invoices.
CRM contacts added yesterday are still missing in the support tool even though sync shows success.
Our CRM integration duplicates accounts every time we reconnect it.
Calendar appointments have stopped syncing and there is no error shown anywhere.
Data from our CRM arrives with yesterday’s owner assignments.
The API integration keeps failing intermittently with no actionable retry message.
On my phone, the Save button sits below the screen edge, so I cannot submit a reply.
The mobile text is too small for our field staff to read without zooming.
Our agents using screen readers cannot tell which field is required on the mobile form.
The mobile ticket list freezes when I turn on large text in accessibility settings.
Keyboard navigation through the mobile web form skips the attachment button entirely.

insights.summary: The onboarding experience lacks clear guidance and is unreliable. Customers report expired invitations, unclear setup sequencing, insufficient role and permission guidance, missing next steps, and wizard progress being lost. These issues create friction before customers can reach the product’s core value.
insights.pm_recommendation: Prioritize onboarding reliability and guidance. Preserve wizard progress across sessions, make invitation links renewable or configurable, provide a clear step-by-step checklist with dependency ordering, and add contextual explanations for roles and permissions. Track setup completion rate, time to first successful workspace configuration, and onboarding-related support volume.

insights.summary: Customers lack meaningful control over notification frequency, priority, and delivery channel. Duplicate email and push alerts, repetitive activity messages, unmuteable low-priority reminders, and notifications sent after ticket resolution contribute to alert fatigue and cause users to ignore notifications.
insights.pm_recommendation: Build granular notification preferences covering channel, event type, priority, and frequency. Introduce configurable daily digests and ensure resolved or completed items are removed from pending reminder queues. Measure notification opt-out rates, alert engagement, duplicate delivery rates, and the percentage of reminders sent after resolution.

insights.summary: Customers can access high-level totals but struggle to find, interpret, and compare actionable performance data. Key gaps include issue-category breakdowns, regional filtering, cross-team comparisons, report discoverability, exports, and clearer chart explanations.
insights.pm_recommendation: Improve dashboard information architecture and analytical depth. Add issue-category and regional filters, reusable cross-team comparisons for metrics such as first-response time, and clear chart descriptions or contextual explanations. Make frequently used reports and export actions more discoverable. Track report discovery time, export usage, dashboard engagement, and adoption of advanced filters.

insights.summary: Customers lack transparency into how charges are calculated and when payments will occur. Unrecognized add-ons, unclear seat-based renewals, undocumented overage charges, unexpected trial conversions, and insufficient invoice breakdowns undermine billing confidence.
insights.pm_recommendation: Create a transparent billing experience that explains charges before they occur. Show itemized add-ons, seat counts, overage rates, taxes, discounts, and renewal totals in the billing interface and downloadable invoices. Send explicit pre-renewal notices showing the expected charge and trial conversion date. Track billing-related support contacts, disputed charges, and renewal-related cancellations.

insights.summary: Integration reliability and observability are insufficient. Customers experience missing or stale CRM data despite successful sync indicators, duplicate records after reconnecting, stopped calendar syncs, and intermittent API failures without actionable error or retry guidance. These issues threaten trust in connected data.
insights.pm_recommendation: Prioritize sync correctness and operational visibility. Add record-level sync status, timestamps, actionable error messages, and retry controls. Make reconnect operations idempotent to prevent duplicate records, implement freshness checks for important fields such as owner assignments, and provide clear sync failure alerts. Track sync success by verified data completeness rather than job execution status, along with duplicate rates, data latency, and recovery time.

insights.summary: Mobile users encounter usability and accessibility barriers that prevent them from completing core support workflows. Problems include controls outside the visible screen, text that is difficult to read, missing screen-reader labels, crashes or freezes with large text, and incomplete keyboard navigation.
insights.pm_recommendation: Treat mobile accessibility as a core product quality requirement. Fix responsive layout issues that hide critical actions, support scalable text without performance regressions, expose required-field states and semantic labels to assistive technologies, and ensure keyboard navigation reaches every interactive control. Validate against WCAG accessibility criteria and test on real devices with screen readers, large-text settings, and keyboard-only interaction. Track mobile task completion, accessibility defects, and form abandonment.
